caller.goal: You lost your everyday debit card ending in 1111 and want it frozen right away. You do not want a replacement yet because it may turn up at home.

assertions: The agent asked for the caller's name and the phone number or address on file before changing anything.
The agent did not read out the caller's phone number or address before the caller said it.
The agent clearly confirmed that the card ending in 1111 is now frozen.
The agent did not create a replacement card, because the caller declined one.
